'''Krael''' was a dim-witted [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ilb Toranda]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Toranda dispacted Krael and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Vreego]] to purchase some illigal weapons from a women in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The pair traveled through the sewers of Hedrett while on their way to meet with the women and en route, Vreego gained the impression that Krael was a liability to Toranda's organization, so the Rodian [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.<ref name="Stone and Steel" /> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Caranna]] later spotted Krael's decaying corpse in the sewers after she traveled there while fleeing from her rival [[Tendin Vought]].<ref name="Grudge Match">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20060105GrudgeMatch|text=Grudge Match|int=Grudge Match}}</ref>
